close_reason: P0-P2 fixes complete; P3/P4 sub-issues remain as backlog
notes:
Maintainer risk: MEDIUM — The two largest risks are the silent null return for unimplemented header forms (will generate user confusion) and the register_mail_handlers auth-context API design decision that cannot be changed without a breaking version bump.
Idiom rating: ACCEPTABLE — No unsafe code, no unwrap in library production paths, no Box<dyn Error> in public APIs, and the type/trait design is sound. The main idiom issues are: (1) gratuitous clone/alloc in hot paths (filter_role_wire, serde_json::from_value(v.clone()), role_to_wire loop), (2) test backend MemoryError is stringly-typed and query_objects uses TYPE_NAME string dispatch defeating generics, (3) SetError missing Display despite SetErrorType having it, (4) repeated 30-site serde_to_value fallback pattern crying out for a helper. Nothing requires a rewrite; all findings are localized fixes.
Rust idiom confidence: 85% chance of missed issue. Least confident flags: (1) email.rs is 2300+ lines — only reviewed the first ~450 lines and specific patterns via grep; the body-structure validation, Email/set update path, and Email/copy path were not fully read. (2) The query_objects filter dispatch in MemoryBackend may have a cleaner trait-based solution that I did not fully work out. Uncertainty driven by: email.rs size limit preventing full read, and not checking whether JmapObject/QueryObject trait bounds would allow trait-level filter dispatch.
Confidence: 20% chance of missed bug. Least confident flags: (1) The blobNotFound notFound property requirement — I verified in RFC 8621 §5.5 but did not verify if the blobId validation path even reaches the backend (the Email/set create currently rejects body part issues via build_email_from_create before calling create_object, so the blobNotFound path may not exist at all rather than returning the wrong error). (2) The onSuccessUpdateEmail immutable-field guard calls find_immutable_patch_key which is defined in crate::email — verified that pub(crate) visibility covers this call site in submission.rs. Uncertainty driven by: not reading the full jmap-server Dispatcher or jmap-types crates to verify JmapError variants map correctly to wire format; not running the test suite to confirm test coverage gaps. Would raise confidence if: ran cargo test --workspace and reviewed test output; checked all the test cases in integration.rs for the specific scenarios flagged.
title: Review: jmap-mail-server round 2
